verdict.rationale: Synthesia is an AI video generation product, so a cheaper draft mode followed by upscaling a chosen take to final quality is a fair question for it. The evidence covers prompt-to-video creation, avatars, dubbing, the Video API, webhooks and MP4 download, but nothing documents a low-cost preview or draft render tier. Nothing shows a way to upscale or re-render a selected take at higher quality either.
